subject: Next Insurance <> Encord
text:
Hi guys,

I moved quickly on my end and attached:

• 
 
A set of dummy data (real daycares pulled from public sources to ensure functional URLs)

• 
 
Google Doc reference:
 https://docs.google.com/document/d/1RHGkQ7XN-snhNfTAJmbk1G9DlAFzUqkX6V0DY_45rS8/edit?tab=t.0#heading=h.md8ei453dsdd

We’re ready to move directly into the demo.

A bit of context on what we’re evaluating:

While image annotation is useful, our longer-term needs across insurance functions are inherently multi-modal. We routinely deal with structured metadata, web research, free-text extraction, citation linking, conditional risk logic, and AI-assisted normalization within a single workflow.

The daycare use case is intentionally designed to test:

• 
 
Modular workflow construction

• 
 
Conditional branching

• 
 
Multi-citation handling

• 
 
AI-assisted formatting layers

• 
 
Structured output generation

• 
 
Human-in-the-loop validation

We’re less focused on the specific vertical and more focused on how your UX supports composability and scale for complex, ongoing annotation programs.

Looking forward to seeing how this can be implemented in your platform.

Best,

Jacob

 On Thu, Feb 19, 2026 at 2:42 PM Laura Zhu < 
laura.zhu@encord.com> wrote:

We'll walk through the Encord platform using your specific use case and also demo multimodal workflows so you'll have an ideal if you take on more projects in the future (e.g. photo + video inspection, side-by-side annotation, etc.)

We are the fastest growing *data labeling and annotation* company based in
India, supporting AI and ML teams with image, video, text, and audio
annotation work.

We have *7+ years of experience* and have completed *2,500+ projects* for
100+ clients, including Fortune 10, Fortune 100, and Global 500 companies.
We follow CMMI Level 3 processes, are ISO 27001 and ISO 9001 certified, and
are an AWS partner.

Our team works on common annotation tasks such as *bounding boxes,
segmentation, key-points, polygons, and similar techniques*, supporting use
cases across computer vision, medical imaging, retail, autonomous systems,
and more.
